_doc: Case Packs (gen/imposter_gen.py --packs). Each pack has `cases` cases of 6 rounds; themes rotate like a season. Pools are pack-<id>-<key>. Only packs whose cases are all generated and approved (--pack-approve) are built into the site. `free` is shown in the UI; the server limit is FREE_PACK_CASES in lib/packs.js.

packs.name: Wildlife
packs.tagline: 30 cases from the field. One creature in every lineup was never born.

themes.name: Owls
prompts: a barn owl perched on a wooden fence post
a tawny owl sitting in the hollow of an old tree
a snowy owl resting on snowy ground
a great horned owl on a branch at dusk
themes.vision: a real owl, its face and body large and clear as the main subject. Alive and in natural surroundings or a natural-looking enclosure; not a drawing, statue, toy, taxidermy or museum specimen, and not a dead or injured animal.
